steps.title: Security config check
steps.description: Checks if the Grafana security configuration is set correctly.
steps.resolution: Follow the documentation for each element.

steps.title: UID validation
steps.description: Checks if the UID of a data source is valid.
steps.resolution: Check the documentation for more information or delete the data source and create a new one.

steps.title: Health check
steps.description: Checks if a data source is healthy.
steps.resolution: Go to the data source configuration page and address the issues reported.

steps.title: Missing plugin check
steps.description: Checks if the plugin associated with the data source is installed and available.
steps.resolution: Delete the datasource or install the plugin.

steps.title: Prometheus deprecated authentication check
steps.description: Checks if Prometheus data sources are using deprecated authentication methods (Azure auth and SigV4)
steps.resolution: Make sure that 'Azure Monitor Managed Service for Prometheus' and/or 'Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus' plugins are installed. If the data source is provisioned, edit data source type in the provisioning file to use 'grafana-amazonprometheus-datasource' or 'grafana-azureprometheus-datasource'.

steps.title: Grafana version check
steps.description: Check if the current Grafana version is out of support.
steps.resolution: Out of support versions will not receive security updates or bug fixes. Upgrade to a more recent version. Learn more about version support.

steps.title: Deprecation check
steps.description: Check if any installed plugins are deprecated.
steps.resolution: Check the documentation for recommended steps or delete the plugin.

steps.title: Update check
steps.description: Checks if an installed plugins has a newer version available.
steps.resolution: There are newer versions available for the plugins listed below. We recommend going to the plugin admin page and upgrading to the latest version.

steps.title: Plugin signature check
steps.description: Checks if the plugin's signature is missing or invalid.
steps.resolution: For security, we recommend only installing plugins from the catalog. Review the plugin's status and verify your allowlist if appropriate.

steps.title: TwinMaker SceneViewer deprecation check
steps.description: Warns when the Grafana IoT TwinMaker App is installed that the SceneViewer panel will stop working in Grafana 13.1.
steps.resolution: The SceneViewer panel in the TwinMaker App will stop working in Grafana 13.1. Ignore or silence this warning if you are not using the SceneViewer panel.

steps.title: SSO List Setting Format Validation
steps.description: Checks if list configs in SSO settings are in a valid list format (space-separated, comma-separated or JSON array).
steps.resolution: Configure the relevant SSO setting using a valid format, like space-separated ("opt1 opt2"), comma-separated values ("opt1, opt2") or JSON array format (["opt1", "opt2"]).
